_about: Chapter titles of NCERT English-medium textbooks, transcribed on 25 Sep 2026 from each book's official contents page (sources/ncert/contents/<code>.txt, cut from https://ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/<code>ps.pdf). One entry per chapter PDF, in the order the NCERT book page lists them. n = the number printed in the contents (absent when NCERT prints none); kind = what NCERT calls the unit (chapter/unit/lesson/theme/project/section); source 'chapter-pdf' = the contents page is an image or mis-encoded there, so the title was read from the first lines of that chapter's own PDF (sources/ncert/chapter-title-lines/). tests/unit/school-spine.test.ts fails if any title is not in its source text. includes = pieces NCERT prints inside that chapter's PDF (unnumbered contents entries between two numbered chapters, unit lessons, numbered parts I/II/III), verbatim from the contents page; page = the printed start page. 26 Sep 2026: 8 titles that wrap onto a second contents line were cut at the first line; corrected and now guarded by the boundary test in tests/unit/school-spine.test.ts.
